name: P12/P11 in the real game (/index.html): people, words, animals, and who is looking at whom

steps.msg: the real game boots with no runtime errors
both plugins are live in /index.html
the vale's fifteen inhabitants are out
the map layer supplied them
everybody has a body
everybody has something to say
nobody had to be shoved off a wall, water or a doorway to stand up

steps.note: THE OPENING FRAME. A child boots the game here. Measure how far away the nearest people are.

steps.eval: (() => { const p = __DQ.state().player; const d = (__DQ.state().npcs||[]).map(n => ({id: n.id, d: +Math.hypot(n.x-p.x, n.z-p.z).toFixed(1)})).sort((a,b) => a.d-b.d); window.__near = d; return JSON.stringify(d); })()

steps.msg: somebody is within six units of the spawn, close enough to read a face

steps.note: a person is solid: you cannot walk through Mrs Pell

steps.eval: (async () => { __DQ.hold('left', 2000); let min = 9; for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) { const p = __DQ.state().player, n = __DQ.state().npcs.find(x => x.id === 'pell'); min = Math.min(min, Math.hypot(p.x - n.x, p.z - n.z)); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 60)); } window.__minDist = +min.toFixed(2); return { closest: window.__minDist, player: __DQ.state().player.x }; })()
